other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Cited reference to prior work on energy utilization in the sanitary ceramics sector (ceramics can be a continuous-flow context), but only appears as a bibliographic citation
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote: Parida M, Wongkot W, Det D. Analysis of energy utilization index in Thailand sanitary ceramics sector.

one_line: The paper empirically evaluates energy baselines and factors affecting energy consumption in Thailand's frozen seafood (shrimp) processing industry, a discrete/batch food-processing context, not continuous-flow industrial production.
